comment: Which upstream compiler crates are ported. Changing this file needs the owner's approval (see AGENTS.md).

excluded.rustc_codegen_llvm: LLVM backend; replaced by our own text-LLVM-IR backend (M7)
excluded.rustc_public: stable MIR API for external tools
excluded.rustc_public_bridge: stable MIR API for external tools
excluded.rustc_incremental: incremental compilation is out of scope
excluded.rustc_thread_pool: parallel frontend is out of scope

miri.comment: Miri, ported like a compiler crate (plan-m6 D2): src/tools/miri/src/<path>.rs -> src/miri/<path>.ts, markers `// rustc: src/tools/miri/src/<path>:<line> <name>`, coverage crate `miri`. `excluded`: paths (files, or directories with everything under them) out of M6's scope, which stop with unported(...). `partial`: files of which only the listed fns are in scope.

excluded.shims/windows: Windows shims; the target is x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (plan-m6 D2)
excluded.shims/unix/socket_address.rs: sockets beyond the isolation error (plan-m6 D2, A3)
excluded.shims/unix/virtual_socket.rs: sockets beyond the isolation error (plan-m6 D2, A3)
excluded.shims/unix/tcp_socket.rs: sockets beyond the isolation error (plan-m6 D2, A3)
excluded.bin/log/tracing_chrome.rs: Chrome trace output of MIRI_TRACING (plan-m6 D2)

shims/unix/socket.rs.reason: plan-m6 A3: only the isolation-error path that run-pass cases reach (`socket`, socket.rs:172 `reject_in_isolation`); with isolation on no socket fd exists, so the other socket shims are unreachable
